title: Inform, Coach, Relate, Listen: Auditing LLM Caregiving Support Roles

bias_targets.methodology: Automated evaluation using the clinician-informed RubRIX framework, where an LLM-as-a-judge flags binary risk components—including a specific dimension for 'Bias & Stigma'—in model-generated responses to Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) caregiver queries.
